correctness.rationale: For every characteristic other than three, flexes form an E[3]-torsor and collinear triples are affine lines; Frobenius acts by an affine transformation with determinant q mod 3 by the Weil pairing. A complete exact 432-map verifier independently enumerates the twelve lines twice and counts fixed lines by both permutation and quotient-space solution criterion; seven determinant-one and three determinant-two spectra have distinct base-field pairs. A complete conjugacy check and F7 division-polynomial arithmetic provide further certificates. The proof is uniform because exhaustive finite-group enumeration covers all possible Frobenius actions, not only sampled curves.

value.rationale: Two geometrically canonical finite-etale configuration schemes over finite fields have base-field rational counts that determine every extension count, with a field-residue restriction and an explicit ten-row inverse map. The new Hesse-line count is demonstrably independent of the rational-flex count on three explicit smooth cubics over F7. The theorem is a motivated arithmetic reconstruction for a classical moduli configuration rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; it does not overclaim curve isogeny or realization of all spectra.
